goal: Test genuinely trained parameters for multihop equality-consistent variable linking on paired public generated graph challenges; do not treat GenEnv hash claims as learned executable models.
source: Use F120 genuine generated public environment vectors with source SHA validation; evaluate both Wingless and Yggdrasil independently. Source-only public synthetic development, never protected scientific originals.

frozen_arms.mechanism: Trainable logistic readout of normalized aggregate path variable-match features. Inputs are explicit local equality bits at traversed edges; no gold labels or oracle truth used as model features. Genuine supervised weight updates; not learned equality discovery.

Trainable sequential state-composition readout using fixed per-hop local equality sensor, recurrent bounded state update, and trained scalar weights. Genuine supervised parameter updates; no gold labels or oracle truth used as model features.
Untrained depth-limited exact variable matcher, maximum 2 hops
Untrained role-only path matcher, ignores variable binding
Exact full variable-binding symbolic oracle, disclosed as upper bound

controls.literal_train_feature: Locally compute equality of adjacent variable-slot IDs only, from input graph edges. No full-path ground-truth value, correct/incorrect flag, candidate source hash, graph seed, or label as feature.
controls.anti_shortcut: Construct paired counterfactuals by swapping distinct existing variable-slot values with a role-incompatible distractor edge; preserve the global multiset of slot values, graph topology, source/target, role list, edges and label balance. Negative has no legitimate complete path.
controls.leakage: TRAIN only updates parameters and selects among A and B using frozen TRAIN split. Holdout CONFIRM never updates, selects, tunes threshold or changes design. Never re-run terminal after seeing results.
controls.training_labels: Only paired public development positive/negative graph truth; no original QA answers or scientific first-use
controls.identity: Separate deterministic seed namespaces, record input graph SHA-256 and model code hash for every result.

metrics.primary: paired correctness on disjoint CONFIRM as fraction of graph-pairs for which model predicts true on positive and false on counterfactual negative; raw and balanced binary accuracy also reported
metrics.train_selection: highest aggregate TRAIN paired correctness, tie to A; select without viewing CONFIRM
metrics.required_relative_gain: Report whether selected model outperforms strongest nonoracle baseline by at least 0.05 balanced accuracy; report exact symbolic oracle regardless.
metrics.scientific_success: None; test establishes narrow supervised source-only engineering learnability, not independent scientific original/generalization or optimizer fitness.

limits.allowed_execution: existing Linux/Windows GitHub native synthetic development workflow only

acceptance: Preimplementation freeze commit first; focused graph-counterfactual and nonleakage adversarial tests; cross-platform deterministic readback; one full Go regression+vet+build at exact source head; draft until evidence and explicit standard protections.
